gaps.note: none of the three CMH-BS-SFDS1U datasheets states a weight, and FS has no shop page for the part.
gaps.wanted: a weight row in a later datasheet, or the part on a scale

gaps.note: FS publishes no render or photograph of CMH-BS-SFDS1U; the model is the drawing alone, and the wall section, the shoulder and hooks, and the colour of the fingers are not shown.

attrs.note: datasheet - material, finger material, colour, temperature, humidity, the environment and the M6 screws and nuts are the specification table of the CMH-BS-SFDS1U datasheet.

bottom.note: drawing - the end view draws the bottom wall as the top one, mirrored.

capacity.note: datasheet - Cable Capacity (Theoretical Value) 48pcs (Cat6 24AWG), the specification table of all three datasheets. No fill basis is stated.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. The back view gives 483 over the ears and 465 between the hole centres; the plan draws the duct 546 px wide, 435.2, between ears of 23.9, which are not drawn. Height 43.8 and depth 70, as dimensioned and as the spec table states them.

color.note: estimated - Color: Black. No image of the part exists; drawn in the shades of the other steel ducts.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. This is Portrayal's reading of the datasheet (portal id 12084, see `sources`): the base is the mounting plane and the duct stands 70 mm in front of it (the end view; see `full-depth`). No fs.com product page for this part was found to check it against. `at` is 70, so all of the depth is in front of the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

fingers.note: drawing - the plan, at 1.2547 px/mm: fifteen slots 13.5 px wide, 10.8, on a pitch of 34.9 px, 27.8, so fourteen fingers 16.9 wide between them and an end block of 17.6 at each end, 435.2 in all. Each slot runs from a round root 19 mm from the back to the shoulder of the wall, 56 from the back, and is open there toward the cover. The shoulder, where the end view steps the wall in by about 5 mm to the hooks the cover clips to, is not drawn: the fingers run straight to the cover.

front.note: estimated - the cover, fitted, over the full face. The fingers are the two slotted walls end-on, 6.0 thick, ESTIMATED: no view draws the wall section, and the back view bounds it, its holes starting 8.3 in from the edge.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the base is the mounting plane and the duct stands 70 mm in front of it (the end view), so the rear face of its rack unit stays free.

guides.note: drawing - the duct is the channel between the two walls, run across the rack; finger pitch 27.8 and the 10.8 slot.

left.note: drawing - the end view, 70 x 43.8: base, the two walls, the cover across the front. The hooks are drawn as the walls; the duct is open at both ends.

method.note: drawing - the embedded drawing (1011 x 565) is 1.2547 px/mm across the 483, 1.256 down the 43.8 and 1.257 along the 70: orthographic, but coarse, about 1.6 mm. No render or photograph of the part is published.

rear.note: drawing - the back view: two obround holes 193 to 194 px long, 154.2, and 34 px high, 27.2, 46.6 apart and symmetric about the middle, from 40.1 to 395.1 across the body.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT. A sheet body whose views are elevations; the solid is the base as a well 68 deep, open at its two holes, the fingers of the two slotted walls standing in it, and the cover, which comes off. The rear view builds the back of the base as sunk plates round the holes.

sources.note: drawing - FS published three datasheets titled CMH-BS-SFDS1U on 2026-10-06 (portal ids 12082, 12083 and 12084), with the same specification table. 12083 and 12084 embed a byte-identical drawing of this part (a plan, the back and an end view, dimensioned 483, 465, 43.8, 31.7 and 70); 12082 embeds a drawing of a 2U dual-sided duct 176 deep (482.6, 465, 87, 176), the numbers of CMH-BS-DFDABS2U, and is not used here. The prose of 12082 and 12083 calls the part ABS plastic, that of 12084 steel; the table of all three says steel with ABS fingers, and 12084 is cited as the datasheet.

thickness.note: estimated - no gauge is stated; 1.2 is taken, as for the other FS steel managers in the library.

top.note: drawing - the plan, rear at y=0: the base, the root of the wall to 19, the fingers and the slots between them, and the cover edge.
